verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository (usemoss/moss) exists, and the CLI package lives in its source tree, so some Moss source appears to be readable. The pack never states a license, though, and it is unclear whether the core runtime or only SDKs and tooling are published. Missing for 10: any evidence of an open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), confirmation that the core search runtime source is published, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Hybrid retrieval (semantic + Keyword Search), built-in embeddings, metadata filtering, and a WebAssembly build that runs in the browser
